Lemma
1. Lemma 5.9\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0105, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0106 ↗ hanlin:weaksol-part1-cz Let $A\subset B\subset Q_1$ be measurable and let $\delta \in (0,1)$. Assume

  • $|A|<\delta $;

  • if a dyadic cube $Q$ satisfies $|A\cap Q|\geq \delta |Q|$, then its predecessor $\widetilde Q$ lies in $B$.

Then $|A|\leq \delta |B|$.

Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma hanlin:weaksol-part1-cz to $\chi _A$ and sum the predecessor-cube estimates inside $B$.

□
